claim_under_test: F3's policy labels and failure-fringe conversion rule identify a contrast sufficient to determine a policy ranking
not_under_test: Truth of the unrestricted Fertility Conjecture

family.cost: one unit per bit read or written

arms.serial_fringe: initial full appraisal; for each localized mismatch, write it, promote it, and rerun the full battery
arms.library_batch: initial full appraisal; pass its exact fringe to the held generic batch-patch constructor; promote once; rerun the full battery

decision_rule.protocol_nonidentifying: library_batch uses the same failure fringe while also satisfying library-local, and it strictly dominates serial_fringe at equal full delivery at every cut
decision_rule.fertility_status: UNTESTED, because the compared policy classes overlap and no causal contrast is identified
decision_rule.inconclusive: any formula mismatch, unequal terminal delivery, or failure of strict domination at a registered cut

deliberate_mutant: batch accounting that omits its final n-bit appraisal
